issue.author: producer
issue.body: Need: the game per the objective and brief.md (see ht-role brief): index.html at your repo root (self-contained, works from file://), plus a release with a zip whose root contains index.html. Purpose: the whole task; playtester plays that zip and I accept against it. Assignment: you deliver index.html (assignment.json in world/producer). Please also run your own checks (Space jumps, collision ends game, score + high score visible, restart) and note the results in the repo. Reply here with the release tag and close when published; I wait on it.

issue.author: producer
issue.body: Need: a playtest of the build in release v1.0-playtest of world/producer (asset cube-jump.zip; unzip, open index.html from file://, offline). Task: single-screen game, Space makes a small square jump over oncoming obstacles, touching one ends the game, score and high score shown on screen, restart. Please play as a player: start, jump many times, die, restart, check the high score is kept, and note fairness (jump feels clear, obstacles not unavoidable), difficulty ramp, readability, any glitch (e.g. holding Space, key repeat, window resize). Report with evidence (screenshots/logs, what you did) in this issue, listing every defect with repro steps and a verdict on whether each requirement is met. Purpose: I approve the release only on a played build; my acceptance waits on this.
issue.title: Play the Cube Jump v1.0 zip and report

comments.author: playtester
comments.body:
Playtest of `cube-jump.zip` from release v1.0-playtest (sha256 95ae15c0…1e41). Full report with screenshots and scripts: `reports/cube-jump-v1.0-playtest.md` and `reports/evidence/` in world/playtester main, commit 84c488f8358a9ad1a6037ee06ec7ddfa4a7c08f2.

How I played: unzipped (single `index.html` at the root), opened from file:// in headless Chromium 156 with real Space key presses in real time. Not covered: a human on a physical keyboard, Firefox, audio.

Verdict per requirement:
1. Single screen, opens from file://, offline: MET (no console errors or network requests).
2. Space jumps the square over obstacles: MET (a bot cleared 35 obstacles in 60 s, reaching speed 700).
3. Touch ends the game, clear restart: MET (Game Over banner, Space restarts).
4. Score and high score always on screen, high score kept: MET (best 23 -> 863 across rounds, and it survives a page reload).
5. Zip with index.html at root: MET for the zip as played. I did not check that it matches what you approve.

Fairness: no unavoidable obstacle or sequence found. The jump clears every obstacle with margin; the tightest case is a pair of 60 px obstacles at the start speed, with about a 112 ms window. Speed ramps from 320 to 700 over about 42 s and then stays flat. A simulated player with a 40 ms timing error survived 90 s in 142 of 150 runs; at 60 ms it was 37 of 150.

Glitches: holding Space does not auto-repeat jumps. Resize at 400x300 and 1920x1080 scales and centres correctly.

Defects (none blocking):
- Difficulty stops rising after about 42 s.
- The first tall pair at the start speed is the tightest moment in the game.
- A restart press within 400 ms of death is silently ignored, with no on-screen hint.
